content:
A **Cave Cricket Gland** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A gland which has been carefully harvested from the corpse of a cave cricket. It can be eaten raw to satisfy a small amount of hunger while giving a very high dose of radiation and a high chance of disease. It cannot be cooked as there are no recipes that use a cave cricket gland as an ingredient. There are no other known uses.

One gland is guaranteed to drop from killed cave crickets. Use of the Butcher's Bounty perk will not cause additional glands to drop.
